title: Structural and mechanistic investigation of the anti-CRISPR protein AcrIE5 using NMR spectroscopy and AlphaFold modeling.
authors: Hong, Sung-Hyun; Kim, Iktae; Lee, Gyujin; Kim, Eun-Hee; Bae, Euiyoung; Suh, Jeong-Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文用NMR和AlphaFold研究抗CRISPR蛋白AcrIE5与CRISPR-Cas Cascade复合物的结合界面，属蛋白-DNA互作体系但非TF-DNA，方法含结构预测与建模，可迁移至TF-DNA界面研究。
abstract: The CRISPR-Cas system employs RNA-guided endonucleases to protect bacteria and archaea from invading bacteriophages and plasmids. In response, bacteriophages have evolved anti-CRISPR proteins that inhibit diverse types of the CRISPR-Cas system. AcrIE5 was discovered from the mobile genetic elements of Pseudomonas aeruginosa, and potently inhibits the type I-E CRISPR-Cas system of P. aeruginosa. Here, we determined the solution structure of AcrIE5 using NMR spectroscopy, which adopts a novel alphabeta fold comprising three alpha-helices and two beta-strands. AcrIE5 harbors a mobile loop between the beta-strands that is conserved among homologs encoded by MGEs infecting Pseudomonas species, but truncated in homologs from MGEs of other bacteria. AlphaFold correctly reproduced the experimental structure of AcrIE5 and predicted its binding at a cleft formed by Cas8e, Cas7e, and Cas5e within the P. aeruginosa type I-E Cascade. The mobile loop and alpha-helices of AcrIE5 mediated key interactions with Cas8e at the PAM recognition site, as well as with adjacent Cas7e and Cas5e. AcrIE5 did not bind individual subunits of Cascade with high affinity, suggesting that it recognizes a composite interface of the functional Cascade assembly. Taken together, our findings suggest that AcrIE5 may compete with DNA binding to the PAM recognition site of type I-E Cascade, similar to AcrIE3 and AcrIE4, and also highlight a potential functional role of the conserved mobile loop in host-specific anti-CRISPR activity.
abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas系统利用RNA引导的内切酶保护细菌和古菌免受入侵噬菌体和质粒的侵害。相应地，噬菌体进化出抗CRISPR蛋白，以抑制多种类型的CRISPR-Cas系统。AcrIE5是从铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）的可移动遗传元件中发现的，并能有效抑制铜绿假单胞菌的I-E型CRISPR-Cas系统。在此，我们利用核磁共振波谱法（NMR spectroscopy）测定了AcrIE5的溶液结构，该结构采用一种新颖的αβ折叠，包含三个α螺旋和两个β链。AcrIE5在β链之间含有一个可移动环，该环在感染假单胞菌属（Pseudomonas）物种的MGE所编码的同源物中保守，但在其他细菌MGE的同源物中被截短。AlphaFold正确重现了AcrIE5的实验结构，并预测其结合于铜绿假单胞菌I-E型Cascade中由Cas8e、Cas7e和Cas5e形成的裂隙处。AcrIE5的可移动环和α螺旋介导了与PAM识别位点处Cas8e以及相邻Cas7e和Cas5e的关键相互作用。AcrIE5不以高亲和力结合Cascade的单个亚基，表明其识别功能性Cascade组装体的复合界面。综合来看，我们的发现表明AcrIE5可能竞争DNA与I-E型Cascade的PAM识别位点结合，类似于AcrIE3和AcrIE4，并同时强调了保守可移动环在宿主特异性抗CRISPR活性中的潜在功能作用。
